text:
sarah: Customer reported that we clicked 'Apply credit' in the support console, saw a green success toast, but the customer still has 0 promo credits in their account. They also got charged for tokens. Can someone look? :frowning:
loren: Can you paste the support console request payload & any response from the backoffice API? thinking it might be async acknowledgement.
max: saw this morning: UI shows success on 202 from admin-service, because we treat 2xx as success. but the actual grant is queued to backoffice-credit-applier. sometimes DLQ issues.
sarah: here's the console response (sanitized):
```
POST /admin/grants 200 OK
{
  "grant_id": "g_04b9f3",
  "status": "queued",
  "message": "enqueued for processing"
}
```
loren: ok queued -> that's expected. can you pull the backoffice logs around g_04b9f3? ops might have DLQ traces.
ops: grabbing logs... one sec.
ops: snippet from backoffice-credit-applier logs:
```
2026-02-28T14:10:03Z ERROR handler.go:87 GrantProcessor failed for g_04b9f3: schema validation error: missing required property 'expires_at'
2026-02-28T14:10:03Z ERROR consumer.go:123 MessageID=kmq-48972 processed -> NACK? acked=true
```
elaine: whoa acked=true despite exception. that explains why it never retried.
max: we recently made 'expires_at' optional -> required in the validation layer (oops) in admin-schema v1.14. front-end sends payload without expires_at (legacy behavior). consumer baseline code swallows error and still acks. classic silent-failure.
sarah: so support console thinks success because initial call enqueued, backoffice died and acked. customer sees success toast but ledger never updated.
billing-bot: Customer impact: credits not applied, tokens charged. Risk: multiple accounts could be affected for the last 12 hours (when v1.14 rolled). alert created INC-2026-348.
loren: repro steps for eng:
1) use support console flow to create grant payload w/o expires_at
2) post to /admin/grants -> get queued response
3) confirm backoffice consumer log shows SchemaValidationError
4) query ledger table:
```
SELECT * FROM grants_ledger WHERE grant_id = 'g_04b9f3'; -- returns 0 rows
```
max: quick fix options:
- patch consumer to not ack on validation error (make ack after DB write) and reprocess DLQ
- alter schema validation to accept missing expires_at (backfill with distant expiry or null) for the short-term
- run a one-off re-run tool that replays messages from tombstone store for affected grant_ids
ops: mitigation I'm doing now: scanning tombstone queue for messages acked-with-error between 2026-02-28T13:45 and 2026-02-28T15:30, collecting grant_ids -> will hand off to lor en for manual reprocess.
loren: I'll add a hotfix: change consumer to return NACK on SchemaValidationError and push to DLQ. will also add a metric for "grant_processor.validation_errors".
elaine: also recommend making the console display 'queued for processing' rather than a green success, so it's clearer for CS to tell customers.
sarah: agreed. for this customer I've manually applied credits to ledger and refunded token charges. case #CS-1129 updated.
loren: commit incoming: revert schema strictness and add compatibility shim for expires_at optional -> required tomorrow. then replay DLQ.
max: created frontend ticket to change toast copy (SUPPORT-apply-toast) and added a small note to the support playbook.
ops: DLQ extract: 47 grant messages found, exporting to secure bucket now. starting replays after lorens patch.
billing-bot: Notifying finance that 12 refunds issued and 47 grants pending re-run.
sarah: thanks everyone. follow-ups: lor en to share PR and replay status, ops to confirm DLQ drain, max to update support docs.
loren: PR: https://repo/repo/commit/abcd1234 - will monitor consumer logs during replay.
ops: replay started at 2026-02-28T17:05Z. first batch applied: 10/47 succeeded, 37 remaining.
sarah: closing loop with customer, marking incident as sevreity: medium. will update once DLQ fully processed. :white_check_mark:
